annotations.title: Last day to appeal a denial

description: The last day to file an appeal of a Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Part D or commercial/ACA/employer plan denial, counted the way the rules count it (Medicare presumes receipt 5 days after the notice date), with days remaining, who decides, and the next level. Not legal advice; confirm the exact date with the official source it names.

level.description: Appeal level; 1 is the first appeal.

noticeDate.description: Date printed on the denial notice, YYYY-MM-DD.

received.description: true if noticeDate is the date the notice was actually received (skips Medicare's 5-day presumption).

name: appeal_deadline
title: Last day to appeal a denial
